description: Poll the status of either a data spec's own process (schema inference + code generation, run by start-analysis — pass specId, reaches "ready" or "failed") or a data-load job (pass jobId, reaches "complete" or "failed"). Pass exactly one of specId or jobId. Right after create-spec/update-spec + start-analysis, poll by specId; once that reaches "ready", its response's lastJobId (if present) points at the data-load job — poll that separately by jobId for load progress.

jobId.description: Poll a data-load job's status. Pass exactly one of specId or jobId.

specId.description: Poll a data spec's analysis status. Pass exactly one of specId or jobId.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to act on. Defaults to your only workspace if you have exactly one.

name: get_status

lastJobId.description: spec poll only: the data-load job triggered once analysis reaches "ready".

metrics.description: Present once a job completes: recordsRead, recordsWritten, filesProcessed, etc.

status.description: e.g. "processing" | "ready" | "failed" for a spec; "processing" | "completed" | "failed" for a job

title: Get spec or job status
